column1: # Game profile of Frostpunk (Switch, update 1.0.1). Plays on the Mac from boot through the title, the main menu and A New Home's intro into the city at 30 fps;
# on Android the same at 30 fps, with the buildings, the Generator and the props drawn through raw global memory (android_defaults.txt, see README.md)
# 11 bit studios' own Liquid engine (namespace N6Liquid; the survey's "Unreal 4" marker is a stray "UE4" in main, there are no paks), NVN, SDK 20.5.19.
# Every game file is in a dozen archives of three files each at the RomFS root (<name>.idx / .str / .dat: zstd entries, sound and movies as Ogg streams);
# shader_split.py reads the 2,550 shaders in common.dat (liquid_shaders), HLSL compiled for NVN, one stage per file
# main imports from these two only; it imports nn::ro, but the RomFS holds no NRO and none was loaded in the runs
# the archives' entries are zstd frames and Ogg streams already
# the NPDM declares no system resource, so no virtual address memory (IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon); main sets a heap of at most the
# pool − 64 MB, which the 3328 MB heap region holds (the log: heap 3.12 GB in a 3.25 GB region, on the Mac and on Android)
# used memory for the rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
